requirements.title: IEEE_GET_HALTING_MODE procedure identity
requirements.source: S17.11.6 p1/p2; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF489.
requirements.definition: IEEE_GET_HALTING_MODE is the simple elemental subroutine whose description is get a halting mode.

pending.IEEE_GET_HALTING_MODE-get-halting-mode-d: Source-use plan imports IEEE_EXCEPTIONS or IEEE_ARITHMETIC and calls IEEE_GET_HALTING_MODE with IEEE_OVERFLOW and a logical variable initialized to an opposite sentinel.
pending.IEEE_GET_HALTING_MODE-simple-elemental-s: Probe IEEE_SUPPORT_HALTING for IEEE_OVERFLOW and IEEE_INEXACT before IEEE_SET_HALTING_MODE setup and IEEE_GET_HALTING_MODE observation. Supported branch calls IEEE_GET_HALTING_MODE for a scalar flag and a rank-one array of those two flags with a conforming logical array, asserts elementwise logical results after explicit setup to .false., then restores saved modes; unsupported branch records skip.

requirements.title: IEEE_GET_HALTING_MODE returns current halting mode
requirements.source: S17.11.6 p3; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF489.
requirements.definition: HALTING shall be logical INTENT(OUT) and receives true for a flag whose exception will cause halting, otherwise false.

pending.IEEE_GET_HALTING_MODE-HALTING-logical-in: Probe IEEE_SUPPORT_HALTING(IEEE_OVERFLOW) before IEEE_SET_HALTING_MODE and IEEE_GET_HALTING_MODE calls. Supported branch initializes HALTING to .true., sets IEEE_OVERFLOW halting mode to .false., calls IEEE_GET_HALTING_MODE, asserts HALTING becomes .false., and restores the saved mode; unsupported branch records skip.
pending.IEEE_GET_HALTING_MODE-returns-halting-st: Probe IEEE_SUPPORT_HALTING(IEEE_OVERFLOW). Supported branch saves current mode, sets IEEE_OVERFLOW halting mode to .false., calls IEEE_GET_HALTING_MODE, asserts .false., and restores the saved mode; unsupported branch records skip. No plan enables halting for an operation.
